authority.source: Owner, 2026-10-25: "I agree the playout-adjustments design as a whole as revised. Once PR #1709 and the two-rectangle follow-up have landed, move the ledger to agreed and prepare the admission of row 32c (phase 1b), row 32d (phase 2) and row 38a (phase 3) as one docs-only change, the way L2.1 was admitted." Preceded by the three decisions of 2026-10-24 recorded in the spec under Owner decisions, the research brief, and three independent second opinions (2026-10-24 and 2026-10-25) whose corrections are folded into the spec. Agreement authorizes the design and its proposed placement; implementation waits for the coordinator to admit each row (32b is admitted), and nothing here edits the run ledger.
